summary: Stablecoin-powered card infrastructure provider supporting card issuance and related payment operations.
U.S. bank identified by Coinbase as the issuer of the current U.S. Coinbase Card.
Card issuing and processing platform identified by Coinbase as powering the current U.S. Coinbase Card.
Provider that manages MetaMask Card account onboarding, KYC and card-site operations according to MetaMask documentation.
Global card network used by multiple crypto card programs in the registry.
Global card network used by multiple crypto card programs in the registry.
Crypto card infrastructure provider and program manager that connects self-custodial wallet balances to regulated card issuance and Visa settlement rails.
Regulated card-issuing partner identified by Gnosis Pay for Gnosis Pay Card and MiniPay Card issuance.
Payment processor identified by Gnosis Pay as a card issuing and processing partner for the Gnosis Pay card stack.
U.S. bank identified by Crypto.com as the issuer of the Crypto.com Visa Signature Credit Card.
European card issuer identified by Nexo for Nexo Card and by current Cryptopay terms as issuer of the Cryptopay Visa debit card.
U.S. bank identified in BitPay cardholder materials as issuer of the BitPay Prepaid Mastercard, in historical Crypto.com U.S. prepaid-card terms, and in an archived U.S. Uphold Mastercard agreement.
Lithuanian entity identified by Bybit's legacy EEA/CH card terms as programme manager of that Bybit Card programme.
French electronic money institution identified by legacy Bybit Card terms as card issuer for EEA countries.
UK electronic money institution identified by legacy Bybit Card terms as card issuer for the United Kingdom.
U.S. bank identified by Gemini as the issuing bank for the Gemini Credit Card.
Crypto payments infrastructure provider identified by Ledger as the provider powering the CL Card compatible with Ledger; narrower legal roles vary by region and are not generalized here.
U.S. bank identified by the current Crypto.com Prepaid Visa Card agreement as the U.S. card issuer.
Crypto.com group entity identified as U.S. program manager for the prepaid Visa card and as the offering entity for the Canadian prepaid Visa program.
Malta financial institution identified by Crypto.com as issuer and promoter of the EEA Crypto.com Prepaid Visa Card under its Visa Principal Member issuing licence.
Canadian bank identified by Crypto.com as issuer of the Canadian Crypto.com Prepaid Visa Card.
Malta electronic money institution identified as issuer for the Wirex EEA Debit Mastercard and the current Bitpanda Visa Card.
Lithuanian Wirex entity identified in EEA card terms as Program Manager for the Wirex Debit Mastercard program.
Singapore Wirex entity identified in Wirex Payment Card terms as Card Issuer for the Singapore program.
Lithuanian electronic-money entity, part of the Solaris group, historically identified as issuer of the prior Bitpanda Visa card and the discontinued European Binance Visa Debit Card.
U.S. bank identified by current Uphold terms as issuer of the Uphold Visa Card.
U.S. Uphold entity identified by current card terms as Program Manager for the Uphold Visa Card.

U.S. bank identified in the BlockFi Rewards Visa Signature Card agreement as the issuing bank. Evolve later stated it had no financial exposure to BlockFi and that outstanding card balances resided with Deserve.

Credit-card platform and servicer identified in the BlockFi Rewards Visa Signature Card agreement; Evolve described BlockFi as Deserve's customer and directed cardholders to Deserve for outstanding card obligations after BlockFi's bankruptcy.
Payment processor through which Coinbase's initial 2015 debit card generation was issued. Coinbase later stated that Shift pivoted its business and rebranded to Apto in 2019.
Electronic-money institution identified by Coinbase as issuer of the Coinbase Card launched in the United Kingdom in 2019 and expanded to additional European countries that year.

Lithuanian electronic-money institution and former Cryptopay card/payment partner whose licence was revoked by the Bank of Lithuania on 2023-06-22; Cryptopay tied discontinuation of its prior EUR card operations to that revocation.
Luxembourg company identified in current Cryptopay Visa Debit Card terms as card programme manager for the DiPocket-issued programme.

Historical prepaid-card issuer used by multiple early crypto-card programs. Visa terminated WaveCrest's Visa membership/card programs in January 2018, disabling dependent cards including the reviewed TenX, Bitwala and European BitPay generations.
Estonian payment institution and Visa Principal Member identified by WhiteBIT as issuer and provider of the WhiteBIT Nova debit card.
Singapore card issuer identified in Bitget Card Asia Pacific terms and launch materials for the APAC Bitget Card generation.
Gibraltar-regulated bank that Xapo's support material identifies as the issuing bank authorising Xapo Card transactions.

Digital-payments infrastructure provider identified by RedotPay as BIN sponsor for the Singapore RedotPay Visa card programme. The reviewed source does not establish an issuer role, so none is assigned.
Swiss financial-services provider identified by SafePal as the provider powering its in-app Fiat Gateway and linked card service.
Regulated card issuer identified by Ready as handling Ready Card KYC/compliance and card issuance while Ready users retain self-custody of wallet assets.
KuCard service partner identified in KuCoin's card terms as providing KuCard services on behalf of Wallester AS. The reviewed terms do not identify UAB EURLITA as issuer.

Issuer name explicitly identified in Oobit's current card terms for the reviewed Oobit Spend Card program. The registry does not expand this name to a different legal entity without additional evidence.
Spanish electronic-money institution identified by Bit2Me as issuer and manager of the Bit2Me card and payment account.
Cyprus electronic money institution identified in Bleap's current EEA cardholder terms as the issuer of the Bleap Mastercard debit card and related e-money.
U.S. bank identified by Gate US as the issuer of the Gate US Visa Debit Card.
Gate US identifies Bridge Ventures LLC as Program Manager for the Gate US Card and describes Bridge infrastructure as supporting stablecoin conversion and payment settlement.
U.S. bank identified by Coinbase as issuer of the Coinbase One Card.
Card platform identified by Coinbase as a company through which the Coinbase One Card is offered. The reviewed Coinbase disclosure does not assign Cardless the regulated issuer role.
Global card network used by the Coinbase One Card under licence from American Express.
Issuer identified by Mercuryo for the Spend virtual card integrated with Ledger Live.
